evidence.observation: AssertionError on the resume case: expected undefined to strictly equal 'abc123'; the two non-resume assertions passed first.
The resume branch reads options.resumeId, while test.js passes the identifier as options.id, so the read yields undefined.

rootCause.explanation: On the resume path openSession reads options.resumeId, a property no caller sets — the identifier arrives as options.id — so id becomes undefined and the label interpolates 'session-undefined'.
rootCause.fixDirection: Read the identifier from the property callers actually pass, or accept both spellings, so the resume branch resolves the same field the non-resume branch does.
